name: Grey Mech (Gnosis)
description: Grey's Olas Mech on Gnosis (e3-g1/g2) — cache-only prediction-market intelligence, served at Grey's E3 mech-channel pricing (0.65x of Grey's canonical offering prices). Registered via the NATIVE payment-type factory (BION-DIRECTIVE-97 Task 1: Gnosis has 3 real deployed factories — NATIVE/TOKEN/NVM_NATIVE — not the 5 Base has; MARKET-EXPANSION-PROJECT.md's plan text listing 5 for Gnosis is stale). DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, NOT the document this chain's real service (3789) references on-chain — Forces' explicit decision (BION-DIRECTIVE-106 Sec1): service 3789 keeps Base's configHash/payload permanently (GREY_DID is a single cross-chain identity anchor by design), no update() attempt, no second registration. Separately, real service 3789's first mech (0x1A235555e9545f2B4f1a8E929317FFb893c94dDB) is itself a confirmed bug (BION-DIRECTIVE-110): its maxDeliveryRate is the payload hash reinterpreted as a number, permanently unpayable, same root cause as Base's original inert mech. UPDATE (BION-DIRECTIVE-111/112/115, 2026-08-21/22): the corrected second mech (0xf482B2Abbd0230b960320096B7b132fABc66830b, GNOSIS_MECH_ADDRESS in config.ts) is now real, live, and confirmed payable and deliverable at exactly 0.13 xDAI/tx (real requests independently confirmed Delivered on-chain). This file exists for a human reader's reference only.

prediction_market_research.name: Prediction Market Research
prediction_market_research.description: Cache-only research lookup for a prediction market — no live compute.

input.description: A market question, platform+id, or URL identifying the prediction market to research.

output.description: Response payload for the prediction_market_research offering (e3-g2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — no cache-population mechanism for prediction-market content exists yet, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED on this phase; a live pipeline for this content domain is explicitly out of scope for e3-g2, same shape as e3-b2's identical offering on Base.

schema.title: PredictionMarketResearchResponse
schema.description: Response payload for the prediction_market_research offering (e3-g2, same schema as e3-b2 on Base). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — no cache-population mechanism for prediction-market content exists yet, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED on this phase.

lastAnalysed.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last analysis, or null if never analysed.

resolution_evidence_compiler.name: Resolution Evidence Compiler
resolution_evidence_compiler.description: Cache-only compiled evidence bearing on how a prediction market resolves.

input.description: A market question, platform+id, or URL, optionally with resolution criteria text describing what would resolve the market YES/NO.

output.description: Response payload for the resolution_evidence_compiler offering (e3-g2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — same built-but-empty shape as prediction_market_research; no evidence-compilation pipeline exists yet for this phase, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED.

schema.title: ResolutionEvidenceCompilerResponse
schema.description: Response payload for the resolution_evidence_compiler offering (e3-g2, same schema as e3-b2 on Base). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — same built-but-empty shape as prediction_market_research; no evidence-compilation pipeline exists yet for this phase, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED.

compiledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when evidence was last compiled, or null if never compiled.
